527:t_010:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you going in on foot?!」

527:t_010:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「As long as my body can move, I'll keep going forward...!」

527:t_010:7.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But you don't know how terrifying $$ミスタ・Ａｇ$$ is.」

527:t_010:10.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「$$ミスタ・Ａｇ$$ has become $$アマルガム$$'s leader. This is a revolution within $$アマルガム$$.」

527:t_010:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ has become $$アマルガム$$'s leader...」

527:t_010:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is convenient for us too.」

527:t_010:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$アマルガム$$'s organic structure supposedly made it impossible to destroy. Now we've found a way to secure a clear victory.」

527:t_010:15.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But your hopes will crumble like nothing! Behold!」

527:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is that the $$アーバレスト$$?!」

527:t_011:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「No... The details are different!」

527:t_011:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This AS... is apparently called the ARX-8.」

527:t_011:3.en:
$n
「Is it the $$アーバレスト$$'s successor?!」

527:t_012:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahahahaha, that's too bad! Thus, $$ミスリル$$'s last hope has been smashed to teeny-tiny pieces by the mighty $$ゲイツ$$!」

527:t_013:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hey, you! This is a great scene! Show a little more enthusiasm!」

527:t_013:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can fight without an AS!」

527:t_013:2.en:
???
「Despite your words, I can see your impatience.」

527:t_013:8.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This reminds me of our reunion in Afghanistan, $$相良宗介$$.」

527:t_013:9.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I've won. That girl has stolen your heart, leaving you wide open.」

527:t_013:11.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「It is as you see. I have joined $$アマルガム$$.」

527:t_013:12.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I will use all my strength to eliminate anyone who opposes $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and the organization.」

527:t_013:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「There must be some reason... You're infiltrating the enemy to disrupt them from inside or something, right?!」

527:t_013:15.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Unfortunately, this is not the sort of decoy operation you imagine.」

527:t_013:16.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I became your enemy of my own free will.」

527:t_013:18.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$相良宗介$$. If you resist, I will order you shot dead without hesitation.」

527:t_013:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I have just one question. Is $$千鳥$$ here?」

527:t_013:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「But you've come for nothing. That girl and $$ミスタ・Ａｇ$$... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ will leave here shortly.」

527:t_013:22.en:
???
「Before that, perhaps I'll stay to witness your end.」

527:t_013:24.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's been a while, $$相良宗介$$.」

527:t_013:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no business with you. Let me see $$千鳥$$.」

527:t_013:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「...You're as unpleasant as ever, shouting like that when you understand nothing.」

527:t_013:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why don't you realize how arrogant you are?」

527:t_013:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care. Hand $$千鳥$$ over.」

527:t_013:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Good grief... It seems talking to you really is impossible.」

527:t_013:30.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ミスタ・Ｋ$$... I'll leave his fate to you.」

527:t_013:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You will die, $$相良宗介$$.」

527:t_013:35.en:
$$宗介$$
(Those eyes, that voice... He's serious. The man I thought of as a father really intends to...)

527:t_013:36.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Okay! $$ミスタ・Ｋ$$ has given his permission!」

527:t_014:2.en:
$n
「Go already, $$宗介$$! Now that you know $$千鳥$$'s here, there's only one thing to do!」

527:t_014:4.en:
$n
「You owe me a large $$銀河ラーメン$$.」

527:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll even authorize a seasoned egg on top.」

527:t_014:6.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Quit playing at your cheesy friendship!」

527:t_014:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'll worry about what the major's thinking later...! Right now... I'll get through this!)

527:t_015:0.en:
$$カリーニン$$
($$相良宗介$$... Even you people cannot overturn this situation.)

527:t_015:1.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(If that did happen, it would prove that this world itself is wrong.)

527:t_016:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Bwahahahahaha! From the look of you, the mission failed!」

527:t_017:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Just give up! It's the bottom of the ninth, two outs, no runners! You're a hundred runs behind!」

527:t_017:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$マデューカス$$... Open the communications channel.」
